video_title: Chandler Parsons says he was GARBAGE when he went to the Euroleague 😭

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on struggling to adjust to Euroleague rules
quotes.quote: Bro, it's a different game. There's no defensive three seconds, there's no goal tending. They call carry on everything. So I remember the first couple weeks, I was garbage. I was so bad. I couldn't adjust to the game. Physical as a motherf***er. They don't call hand checks over there. It is a completely different game.
